1003.m_mDesc: "Reverse the flow of time, thousands upon thousands of times—the ending endures... or does it shift?"

1004.m_mDesc: "As the sands fall and the clock turns, shatter the chains, only to face a new cage."

1005.m_mDesc: "The Carrelle emblem, a beacon of family pride—yet its weight is too great for the unworthy to carry."

1006.m_mDesc: "Etched on the back: 'In memory of our leader, Carrelle...' The rest is worn away, erased by time."

1007.m_mDesc: "Ironfist, the most mysterious prison of legend, said to hold criminals who committed unforgivable sins."

1008.m_mDesc: "No eyes have glimpsed that prison, and no soul has left it. Doom is all that awaits within."

1009.m_mDesc: "They say the Church sent its most ruthless warden to rule over Ironfist—a land so forsaken, even Aeon withholds its blessing."

1010.m_mDesc: "Shiny things are Joyce's favorite. What to trade them for? Food, water, or perhaps... a chance to escape."

1011.m_mDesc: "Joyce loves generous customers, but trust is something even Joyce can't buy."

1012.m_mDesc: "What do you want to buy? A warden... then that alone isn't enough. Blood—Joyce needs more blood."

1013.m_mDesc: "A ticket to nowhere. Who will it choose, and what lies ahead?"

1014.m_mDesc: "A prisoner claims this ticket hails from a grand, golden vessel."

1015.m_mDesc: "Only one ticket, only one chance. Who will you free from this cage?"
